messages.author: 46ae78ea00946252
messages.subject: Gis non habitat shapes
parts:
Dear all, 
I was wondering if anyone could help me with a tutorial about how we can exclude areas of non-habitat of a habitat mask using a polygon from ArcGis (in arcGis or in Rstudio)?
I have a shapefile of my study area that, besides Atlantic Forest, includes several lakes that I would like to exclude from the mask (non-habitat areas) to estimate puma density. I have the shapefile of the lakes as well. 

Thank you in advance.

Fernando

messages.author: d97adc7d990b76a0
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Gis non habitat shapes
parts:
Hi Fernando,

You can use the erase tool in arcgis with the input of your mask layer and the lakes layer to erase that area. I haven't used this mask with holes in a secr model before so I'm not sure if you will have any issues at the moment of analysis.

https://pro.arcgis.com/en/pro-app/latest/tool-reference/analysis/erase.htm

Best,
Matt
